title: parosela divaricata var. cinerea
intro: Parosela divaricata var. cinerea, commonly known as the Grey Parosela, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Parosela divaricata var. cinerea include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may provide relief from various health conditions.
